question: Which among the following is a viral disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chicken pox**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chicken pox:

 
 
• ​The virus that causes chickenpox is known as varicella-zoster.
 
• It results in a small number of fluid-filled blisters and an itchy rash.
 
• People who have never had chickenpox or who haven't received the vaccine are very contagious.
 
• Within 10 to 21 days of coming into contact with a virus carrier, symptoms start to manifest.
 
• The average recovery time is two weeks.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
